title: New image and video models, ready for creative mischief
summary:
A creative-model day: new Krea, Grok video, and Qwen capabilities, backed by sturdier deployments and community publishing.

Krea 2 Medium joined the image API with text-to-image generation, aspect-ratio support, and reproducible seeds. Grok Imagine Video 1.5 also landed, bringing video generation with synchronized audio and 480p through 1080p output.

qwen3.8-max is now available for text, image, and video inputs, routed directly through Alibaba on OpenRouter. Explicit routing means builders get the intended model rather than a mysterious substitute from the model cupboard.

pollinations-router can now publish community models using its immutable GitHub account ID instead of relying on a username that may someday wander off and reinvent itself.
